found_by: the first time the audit provoked a real refusal, the pearl-white face reported the error ink below AA verbatim: 3.48:1 need>=4.5:1 13px fg=rgb(240, 82, 82) on p#as-form-error.error across 8 runs (both widths, plus plan-detail/compare/feedback)
root_cause: :root defines --color-error:#F05252 for the charcoal default; ui2026/light already re-points it to var(--uif-light-danger) (style.css:1770) but the stitch/light block did not, so pearl white inherited a red chosen for a dark ground
fix: re-point --color-error in the stitch/light scope to the existing measured token --uif-light-danger #ab384d -- computed by the gate own compositing maths: 6.17 on white, 5.69 on #F4F6F8, 5.20 on the light elevate. No new red is invented: the pack declares six values and none of them is an error colour. The charcoal default is untouched.
